description: When one of two participating databases is closed inside the open level, what does a later Rollback reverse in each file? Workspaces(0) with db = OpenDatabase(main, writable) and dbb = Workspace.OpenDatabase(second file B, writable) before any level; A = UPDATE T SET V = 101 WHERE ID = 1 on db; B = UPDATE T SET V = 5001 WHERE ID = 1 on dbb (both dbFailOnError). BeginTrans; A; B; dbb.Close; DBEngine.Errors; Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; read db; close db; read both through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
